data.name: Bumming It
data.detailed_description:
THE HOUSE ALWAYS WINS

Start with nothing. Do whatever comes next.

Bumming It is an open-world life sandbox where you and your friends are dropped into a world full of ways to make money, waste money, and make questionable decisions.

Take jobs. Hustle. Gamble away your paycheck. Go fishing instead. Collect and trade cards. Buy a place and make it yours. Get involved in crime. Or spend the entire day screwing around with your friends and accomplish absolutely nothing.

There isn't one right way to make a life.

MAKE A LIVING

Everybody needs money. How you get it is up to you.

Take on jobs and deliveries, find opportunities around town, build up your cash, or look for less-than-legal ways to get ahead. As you progress, new opportunities, purchases, and ways to spend your time become available.

Just remember: making money and keeping it are two very different things.

WASTE IT ALL

What good is a paycheck if you can't immediately make a terrible financial decision?

Hit the tables and play poker with your friends. Buy and open trading card packs. Spend your money on your home, hobbies, and whatever else catches your eye.

Or grab a fishing rod and forget about your responsibilities for a while.

The house always wins.

YOUR LIFE, YOUR PROBLEM

Buy a home, furnish it, decorate it, and make it your own. Explore the world, discover new activities, complete challenges, and work toward new unlocks as you build whatever kind of life you want.

You don't have to become a criminal.

You don't have to become rich.

You don't even have to be productive.

MAKE BAD DECISIONS TOGETHER

Everything is better ... or considerably worse, with friends.

Jump online and build a life together. Work jobs, explore, gamble, fish, get into fights, commit crimes, show off your latest card pulls, or simply see what happens when a group of friends is given a world full of things they probably shouldn't be doing.

Play your way, alone or with friends.

START WITH NOTHING

Where you end up is up to you.

Work hard. Get rich. Blow it all. Start over. Chase collectibles. Buy a home. Become a criminal. Become the world's most dedicated fisherman.

Or don't do any of that.

It's your life to waste.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 2060 or RX 7600 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Bumming It contains stylized, bloodless violence, including fighting, firearms, and other weapons. Characters may be knocked out or incapacitated during combat.

The game also depicts criminal activity, gambling with in-game currency, and the use of fictionalized illegal drugs and alcohol. Some dialogue and humor may include strong language, crude humor, and mild sexual references or innuendo.

The game does not contain graphic violence, gore, nudity, or explicit sexual content.
